messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate (gateway) + 4x increase in fallback-to-compatible-models in us-west-2 over last 3m. Error spike coincides with traffic surge from client cluster A. Pager: @jen @mike
jen: seeing it, joining. what do metrics say on retry rates?
xavier: retry spikes from client A -> HTTP 503 -> client retries with backoff 500ms causing a retry storm. fallback routing policy is configured to failover to smaller quantized variant in other region (eu-west-1) when latency>200ms. looks like failover triggers, which increases cross-region traffic and latency -> more failovers. feedback loop.
mike: acked. can we temporarily disable cross-region fallback?
jen: yes. if we turn off cross-region fallback policy traffic should stay in us-west-2 and avoid the loop. will put a short change and monitor.
emma: CS: we have two paying customers on affected endpoints seeing timeouts. they're on shared hosted tier. status page note needed?
raj: i'm seeing the policy misconfig: smart-routing has "prefer_local: false" set for this model family. it should be true for latency-sensitive routes. probably a bad rollout earlier.
xavier: also the client retry policy is aggressive: jitter disabled. clients do immediate exponential but min 200ms. when combined with server-side failover that spins up proxies in target region we double traffic.
jen: mitigation plan: 1) disable cross-region fallback for model: text-embed-v2 on routing-policy 2) add short term per-customer token rate limit 3) flip client-facing header to 429 on queue saturation 4) roll forward corrected prefer_local=true to policy service 5) notify CS. doing 1 & 2 now.
mike: I'll take 2 & 3. raj, can you prepare the policy patch?
raj: patch ready. applying in 2 steps: canary then global. canary -> will only affect prod routing controller. command: ```
# canary update
curl -X POST https://config.internal/policy/update -d '{"model":"text-embed-v2","prefer_local":true}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $POLICY_TOKEN" 
```
jen: applying disable of cross-region fallback now: ```
# disable fallback for embed routes
curl -X POST https://config.internal/policy/update -d '{"model":"text-embed-v2","allow_cross_region_fallback":false}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $POLICY_TOKEN"
```
oncall-bot: Deploy job started for policy-service (deploy-3789). CI checks passed.
xavier: after flip i see failover count drop ~70% and 5xxs trending down. retry rate still high though. need to throttle client A.
mike: added per-token rate limit for the specific tokens driving the spike: ```
# rate limit
curl -X POST https://api.internal/rate_limit -d '{"token":"tok_ABC123","max_rps":20}'
```
emma: notifying affected customers now w/ ETA 30m for mitigation. message: "We're seeing intermittent timeouts on embeddings in us-west-2; mitigation in progress, some requests may be rate-limited. No data loss."
raj: can we fast-fail on overload instead of directing to smaller models? circuit breaker config change: set failure_threshold=0.05, window=30s -> fast 429s. pushing change.
jen: rolling circuit breaker now. also increasing capacity of embed pool in us-west-2 by scaling dedicated pods +1. ```
kubectl scale deployment/embed-pool --replicas=9 -n inference
```
xavier: pods coming up. backend latency improving. looks like we avoided a full thundering-herd. request volume normalized after client token rate limit.
mike: oncall handoff in 20m, i'll be on second shift. jen, please capture tl;dr for handoff and incident bridge notes.
jen: tl;dr: retry storm amplified fallback -> cross-region failovers -> added latency -> more retries. Root cause: routing policy misconfig (prefer_local=false) and aggressive client retry without jitter. Mitigations applied: disabled cross-region fallback for text-embed-v2, per-token rate limits for offending clients, circuit-breaker fast-fail config, scaled embed pool. Monitoring: 5xx down 85%, fallbacks down 90%.
emma: CS update posted to customers and status page. two customers acknowledged with reduced traffic after rate-limit.
raj: roots/action items: 1) policy-service rollout validation + add canary checks for prefer_local flag (assigned raj) 2) add server-side synthetic to detect fallback cascades and auto-throttle (assigned xavier) 3) communicate recommended retry-with-jitter SDK config to customers + outbound email (assigned emma) 4) incident postmortem (jen)
mike: taking on-call handoff. i'll keep monitoring for 2hrs. tagging incident Sev: SEV2 for now.
oncall-bot: Incident annotated: incident_id=INC-2246-1, severity=SEV2, responders=[jen,mike,xavier,raj,emma].
jen: good job team. follow up doc: please add timeline + logs to the postmortem doc. i'll start drafting the RCA. :thumbsup:
